hotels.title: Stylish Busan Stay in Yeonsan with Contemporary Comfort
hotels.description: Set in Yeonsan, this contemporary stay places you between Busan’s civic heart and the coastal districts beyond. Yeonsan Station is close by, linking you to Seomyeon’s shopping streets and Gwangalli Beach in minutes. Rooms are styled with clean lines and practical comforts, while the lobby keeps things polished and modern. Nearby, diners can sample milmyeon, dwaeji-gukbap and seafood at local favourites around Busan City Hall and the nearby markets
